title: ARIA tree
description: One Playwright ariaSnapshot() per screen, parsed into an annotatable node tree - pragma's own x-namespaced facts (x-axtree-ref, the same convention catalog's x-observed-variants already uses) ride alongside the real ARIA role/name vocabulary. See docs/adr/0003-tree-aria-snapshot-contract.md.

state.description: Always 'default' until state detection lands - see ADR-0003's snapshot policy.

x-axtree-ref.description: JSON Pointer into this screen's own entry in tree.axtree.json's nodes array, e.g. '/nodes/42'. Absent when no matching AXTree node was found.
